en.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

zhSimplified.text: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的元年，耶和华论犹大众民的话临到耶利米。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬第四年，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的元年，耶和華論猶大眾民的話臨到耶利米。

en.text: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

zhSimplified.text: 先知耶利米就将这话对犹大众人和耶路撒冷的一切居民说：

zhTraditional.text: 先知耶利米就將這話對猶大眾人和耶路撒冷的一切居民說：

en.text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the LORD’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

zhSimplified.text: 「从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚十三年直到今日，这二十三年之内，常有耶和华的话临到我；我也对你们传说，就是从早起来传说，只是你们没有听从。

zhTraditional.text: 「從猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞十三年直到今日，這二十三年之內，常有耶和華的話臨到我；我也對你們傳說，就是從早起來傳說，只是你們沒有聽從。

en.text: The LORD has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华也从早起来，差遣他的仆人众先知到你们这里来（只是你们没有听从，也没有侧耳而听），

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華也從早起來，差遣他的僕人眾先知到你們這裏來（只是你們沒有聽從，也沒有側耳而聽），

en.text: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 说：『你们各人当回头，离开恶道和所作的恶，便可居住耶和华古时所赐给你们和你们列祖之地，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 說：『你們各人當回頭，離開惡道和所作的惡，便可居住耶和華古時所賜給你們和你們列祖之地，直到永遠。

en.text: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”

zhSimplified.text: 不可随从别神事奉敬拜，以你们手所做的惹我发怒；这样，我就不加害与你们。

zhTraditional.text: 不可隨從別神事奉敬拜，以你們手所做的惹我發怒；這樣，我就不加害與你們。

en.text: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says the LORD, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”

zhSimplified.text: 然而你们没有听从我，竟以手所做的惹我发怒，陷害自己。这是耶和华说的。』」

zhTraditional.text: 然而你們沒有聽從我，竟以手所做的惹我發怒，陷害自己。這是耶和華說的。』」

en.text: Therefore the LORD of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

zhSimplified.text: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：「因为你们没有听从我的话，

zhTraditional.text: 所以萬軍之耶和華如此說：「因為你們沒有聽從我的話，

en.text: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says the LORD, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

zhSimplified.text: 我必召北方的众族和我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击这地和这地的居民，并四围一切的国民。我要将他们尽行灭绝，以致他们令人惊骇、嗤笑，并且永久荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 我必召北方的眾族和我僕人巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來攻擊這地和這地的居民，並四圍一切的國民。我要將他們盡行滅絕，以致他們令人驚駭、嗤笑，並且永久荒涼。這是耶和華說的。

en.text: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

zhSimplified.text: 我又要使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光，从他们中间止息。

zhTraditional.text: 我又要使歡喜和快樂的聲音，新郎和新婦的聲音，推磨的聲音和燈的亮光，從他們中間止息。

en.text: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

zhSimplified.text: 这全地必然荒凉，令人惊骇。这些国民要服事巴比伦王七十年。

zhTraditional.text: 這全地必然荒涼，令人驚駭。這些國民要服事巴比倫王七十年。

en.text: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says the LORD, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

zhSimplified.text: 七十年满了以后，我必刑罚巴比伦王和那国民，并迦勒底人之地，因他们的罪孽使那地永远荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 七十年滿了以後，我必刑罰巴比倫王和那國民，並迦勒底人之地，因他們的罪孽使那地永遠荒涼。這是耶和華說的。

en.text: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 我也必使我向那地所说的话，就是记在这书上的话，是耶利米向这些国民说的预言，都临到那地。

zhTraditional.text: 我也必使我向那地所說的話，就是記在這書上的話，是耶利米向這些國民說的預言，都臨到那地。

en.text: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为有多国和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴仆；我也必照他们的行为，按他们手所做的报应他们。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為有多國和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴僕；我也必照他們的行為，按他們手所做的報應他們。」

en.text: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—以色列的 神对我如此说：「你从我手中接这杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各国的民喝。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－以色列的上帝對我如此說：「你從我手中接這杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各國的民喝。

en.text: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们喝了就要东倒西歪，并要发狂，因我使刀剑临到他们中间。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們喝了就要東倒西歪，並要發狂，因我使刀劍臨到他們中間。」

en.text: Then I took the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:

zhSimplified.text: 我就从耶和华的手中接了这杯，给耶和华所差遣我去的各国的民喝，

zhTraditional.text: 我就從耶和華的手中接了這杯，給耶和華所差遣我去的各國的民喝，

en.text: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

zhSimplified.text: 就是耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑，并耶路撒冷的君王与首领，使这城邑荒凉，令人惊骇、嗤笑、咒诅，正如今日一样。

zhTraditional.text: 就是耶路撒冷和猶大的城邑，並耶路撒冷的君王與首領，使這城邑荒涼，令人驚駭、嗤笑、咒詛，正如今日一樣。

en.text: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;

zhSimplified.text: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣仆、首领，以及他的众民，

zhTraditional.text: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣僕、首領，以及他的眾民，

en.text: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

zhSimplified.text: 并杂族的人民和乌斯地的诸王，与非利士地的诸王（亚实基伦、迦萨、以革伦，以及亚实突剩下的人）；

zhTraditional.text: 並雜族的人民和烏斯地的諸王，與非利士地的諸王（亞實基倫、迦薩、以革倫，以及亞實突剩下的人）；

en.text: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

zhSimplified.text: 以东、摩押、亚扪人、

zhTraditional.text: 以東、摩押、亞捫人、

en.text: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

zhSimplified.text: 泰尔的诸王、西顿的诸王、海岛的诸王、

zhTraditional.text: 泰爾的諸王、西頓的諸王、海島的諸王、

en.text: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

zhSimplified.text: 底但、提玛、布斯，和一切剃周围头发的；

zhTraditional.text: 底但、提瑪、布斯，和一切剃周圍頭髮的；

en.text: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

zhSimplified.text: 阿拉伯的诸王、住旷野杂族人民的诸王、

zhTraditional.text: 阿拉伯的諸王、住曠野雜族人民的諸王、

en.text: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

zhSimplified.text: 心利的诸王、以拦的诸王、米底亚的诸王、

zhTraditional.text: 心利的諸王、以攔的諸王、米底亞的諸王、

en.text: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

zhSimplified.text: 北方远近的诸王，以及天下地上的万国喝了，以后示沙克王也要喝。

zhTraditional.text: 北方遠近的諸王，以及天下地上的萬國喝了，以後示沙克王也要喝。

en.text: “You shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’

zhSimplified.text: 「你要对他们说：『万军之耶和华—以色列的 神如此说：你们要喝，且要喝醉，要呕吐，且要跌倒，不得再起来，都因我使刀剑临到你们中间。』

zhTraditional.text: 「你要對他們說：『萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：你們要喝，且要喝醉，要嘔吐，且要跌倒，不得再起來，都因我使刀劍臨到你們中間。』

en.text: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

zhSimplified.text: 「他们若不肯从你手接这杯喝，你就要对他们说：『万军之耶和华如此说：你们一定要喝！

zhTraditional.text: 「他們若不肯從你手接這杯喝，你就要對他們說：『萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們一定要喝！

en.text: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of Armies.”’

zhSimplified.text: 我既从称为我名下的城起首施行灾祸，你们能尽免刑罚吗？你们必不能免，因为我要命刀剑临到地上一切的居民。这是万军之耶和华说的。』

zhTraditional.text: 我既從稱為我名下的城起首施行災禍，你們能盡免刑罰嗎？你們必不能免，因為我要命刀劍臨到地上一切的居民。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。』

en.text: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘The LORD will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 「所以你要向他们预言这一切的话，攻击他们，说： 耶和华必从高天吼叫， 从圣所发声， 向自己的羊群大声吼叫； 他要向地上一切的居民呐喊， 像踹葡萄的一样。

zhTraditional.text: 「所以你要向他們預言這一切的話，攻擊他們，說： 耶和華必從高天吼叫， 從聖所發聲， 向自己的羊群大聲吼叫； 他要向地上一切的居民吶喊， 像踹葡萄的一樣。

en.text: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 必有响声达到地极， 因为耶和华与列国相争； 凡有血气的，他必审问； 至于恶人，他必交给刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 必有響聲達到地極， 因為耶和華與列國相爭； 凡有血氣的，他必審問； 至於惡人，他必交給刀劍。 這是耶和華說的。

en.text: The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，必有灾祸从这国发到那国， 并有大暴风从地极刮起。

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華如此說： 看哪，必有災禍從這國發到那國， 並有大暴風從地極颳起。

en.text: The slain of the LORD will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 「到那日，从地这边直到地那边都有耶和华所杀戮的。必无人哀哭，不得收殓，不得葬埋，必在地上成为粪土。

zhTraditional.text: 「到那日，從地這邊直到地那邊都有耶和華所殺戮的。必無人哀哭，不得收殮，不得葬埋，必在地上成為糞土。

en.text: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.

zhSimplified.text: 牧人哪，你们当哀号，呼喊； 群众的头目啊，你们要滚在灰中； 因为你们被杀戮分散的日子足足来到。 你们要跌碎，好像美器打碎一样。

zhTraditional.text: 牧人哪，你們當哀號，呼喊； 群眾的頭目啊，你們要滾在灰中； 因為你們被殺戮分散的日子足足來到。 你們要跌碎，好像美器打碎一樣。

en.text: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.

zhSimplified.text: 牧人无路逃跑； 群众的头目也无法逃脱。

zhTraditional.text: 牧人無路逃跑； 群眾的頭目也無法逃脫。

en.text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for the LORD destroys their pasture.

zhSimplified.text: 听啊，有牧人呼喊， 有群众头目哀号的声音， 因为耶和华使他们的草场变为荒场。

zhTraditional.text: 聽啊，有牧人呼喊， 有群眾頭目哀號的聲音， 因為耶和華使他們的草場變為荒場。

en.text: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华发出猛烈的怒气， 平安的羊圈就都寂静无声。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華發出猛烈的怒氣， 平安的羊圈就都寂靜無聲。

en.text: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

zhSimplified.text: 他离了隐密处像狮子一样， 他们的地，因刀剑凶猛的欺压， 又因他猛烈的怒气都成为可惊骇的。」

zhTraditional.text: 他離了隱密處像獅子一樣， 他們的地，因刀劍凶猛的欺壓， 又因他猛烈的怒氣都成為可驚駭的。」
